symptom: Official PR CI #40084683828 failed one new synthetic proof-request allowlist test: a forbidden substring check for 'trusted' matched the permitted schema version suffix 'untrusted'. The request contained no trusted flag. This was an assertion design error, not a verifier or research runtime failure.
lesson: Searching the serialized JSON for a forbidden bare substring does not prove a forbidden field exists: an allowed literal such as 'untrusted' contains the token 'trusted'. A negative security fixture must test structural key identity separately from permitted value text.
guardrail: When asserting that trust-granting fields are absent, inspect exact own property names or quoted JSON keys instead of bare substring matches. Keep allowlist tests for sensitive raw fields and prove self-reported metadata still returns independentAuthorityVerified=false and scoringAuthorized=false. Inspect full CI job logs before attributing the failure.
